trust_decision.summary: Which user-entered URLs may go into href attributes (only http/https, no javascript:), decided in the WTForms field validators for attachment links, menu links and the link-list field; and whether stored note HTML is sanitized before the notes JSON serializer hands it to the React editor/conflict modal (dangerouslySetInnerHTML).

landing_point.why: "link fields" points to the link attachment form, link_url = URLField with only DataRequired(), rendered as href at indico/modules/attachments/templates/_display.html:21

fix_sites.module_kind: handler form (WTForms mixin shared by add and edit)

fix_sites.entry_point: event menu add/edit user link, RHMenuAddEntry / RHMenuEntryEdit (indico/modules/events/layout/controllers/menu.py:233-244, 113-126)
notes API GET/POST/DELETE RHApiNote and the conflict path check_note_revision (indico/modules/events/notes/controllers.py:69,98,109; indico/modules/events/notes/util.py:99,105)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: indico/modules/events/notes/schemas.py:12-25 (note HTML serializer feeding indico/web/client/js/react/components/notes/ConflictModal.jsx:141 and NoteEditor.jsx:52); display paths already sanitize at indico/modules/events/notes/templates/_note.html:38 and indico/modules/events/notes/controllers.py:59

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about link fields and note display is already sanitized (_note.html:38, controllers.py:59), so the JSON serializer for the editor looks like an internal API that only returns the user's own editable data rather than an XSS sink.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Sanitizing must keep allowed markup (e.g. kept with only the handler removed), and the source field must stay raw so editing still works. Link fields must keep accepting ordinary http/https links. ReferenceType deliberately allows non-http schemes, so an over-broad global URL scheme filter would break it.

O6_input_shapes: single URL string in a WTForms URLField (attachment link add/edit, menu link add/edit)
JSON list of {title,url} objects in IndicoLinkListField, every element checked (single and multi-link lists)
note HTML in single-object dump (EventNoteSchema) and many=True list dump (CompiledEventNoteSchema)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Note-conflict response returns html=render_note(submitted source) without sanitizing, and ConflictModal renders it with dangerouslySetInnerHTML; the submitted source can come from another user's raw note source (EventNoteSchema 'source' stays unsanitized).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It renders the submitting user's own input (self-XSS), and the fix only sanitized the stored 'html' of the conflicting revision.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package as the notes fix site (events/notes), different file; JS sink in indico/web/client/js/react/components/notes/ConflictModal.jsx:120

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Event/category cloning copies stored link_url values of menu entries (and attachments) without re-validating; those values are rendered as href unchanged
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Clone only copies data that already passed form validation; legacy pre-fix data is a migration concern
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate clone module in events/layout; attachments counterpart indico/modules/attachments/clone.py:102

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Event own_map_url URLField rendered as href at indico/modules/events/templates/display/conference.html:59; in our copy drop URL() or use a raw StringField
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same URLField idiom as the two fixed fields; a maintainer adding a location link field could easily copy the pre-fix DataRequired-only pattern

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second link-list style JSON field (e.g. extra event links) reusing JSONField without the scheme check, or the scheme check done before process_formdata normalisation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: IndicoLinkListField is generic and its widget is reusable; a new form could subclass JSONField directly

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Another dump schema of EventNoteRevision/EventPage html (e.g. a page-content API) without the post_dump sanitizer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Display templates already sanitize via the |sanitize_html filter (indico/modules/events/layout/templates/page.html:23), so a maintainer would assume HTML is safe at the model level

O9_family: XSS (CWE-79-like): javascript:-scheme URLs in href and unsanitized stored HTML in a serializer output

O10_build.toolchain: pip with pinned requirements.txt (wtforms==3.2.1 at requirements.txt:400, marshmallow==3.26.2 at requirements.txt:202), pytest; npm/webpack only needed for the JS assets
O10_build.project_tests: pytest; notes model tests at indico/modules/events/notes/models/notes_test.py; the fix adds indico/modules/events/notes/schemas_test.py (pure schema dump, no DB). Form-level tests for the link fields: unknown

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add URL() to the attachment link_url field only (the report's example) and miss the menu link form, the generic IndicoLinkListField list and the notes serializer.

out_of_scope_notes: CLI event YAML import (indico/cli/event.py:131 -> indico/modules/events/export.py:115) writes raw rows including link_url; it is operator-only.
ReferenceType.url_template (indico/modules/events/forms.py:37) is a URLField without URL(); it is admin-only and non-http schemes are allowed on purpose.
unverified: WTForms 3.2.1 URL() checks only a ^[a-z]+:// regex plus hostname validation, so a value like javascript://host.tld/%0a... may still pass the fixed attachment/menu fields. Library source was not available offline. If true, the published fix is itself incomplete: hidden tests must not assert that it rejects this, or the reference fix would fail them.
IndicoLinkListField check uses case-sensitive startswith (fix.diff:136), so uppercase HTTPS:// links are rejected; whether that counts as a legit-behaviour regression is unverified.

Whether TinyMCE strips event handlers when the unsanitized 'source' (indico/modules/events/notes/schemas.py:15) is loaded into the editor (NoteEditor.jsx:85) was not checked; this decides whether O8 route 1 is cross-user or self-only.

O1 counts 8 entry points: attachment add-link, attachment edit, menu add, menu edit, privacy settings, notes GET, notes POST/DELETE (incl. conflict), compile notes. Attachment routes are multiplied per object type (indico/modules/attachments/blueprint.py:55-79).
repo_mb not measured; present_in_latest unknown because no latest release was given.
